summary: 2026-27 home kit (black jersey, light-blue 'Д' letter crest, unchanged from last season per the KHL's official kit blog). On the kit: BSB Bank logo on the front hem, yellow Maxline patches on the shoulders, Gazprom transgaz Belarus (general partner) across the back below the numbers (and large on the away front), Belavia wordmark on the pants shell; the МИР chest patch and СОГАЗ helmet sticker are KHL league placements on every club. Beyond the kit, every commercial partner named on the club's partners page is listed above: BAZ, Minsk-Arena, Alivaria, Konus, BelBet, Olympia Gym & SPA, Minsk Margarine Plant, Lidkon, Ticketpro, Bank VTB (Belarus), Aigenis, Sber Bank (Belarus), Na'Svyazi, TEZ TOUR. Not complete: one sticker on the helmet was not legible in photos; two information (media) partners on the partners page (Humor FM, Avtoradio) are not sponsors and were omitted.
